Remove a model

How to Delete an Ollama Model and Check Disk Space

Run ollama list, copy the full model name and tag, then remove it with ollama rm NAME:TAG. Run ollama list again to confirm the tag is gone. If you only need to free running memory, use ollama stop NAME:TAG instead. Files shared with another installed tag can stay on disk after deletion.

  1. Choose what to free
  2. Check the server, tag and folder
  3. Unload from memory
  4. Remove one installed tag
  5. Check disk usage and shared files

Before deleting a custom model you may need again, keep its original GGUF and Modelfile outside Ollama’s store. A recipe that refers to a weight file inside the store may stop working after the last tag using it is removed.

What do you need to free?

See stepsSee stepsSee steps

Check the server, tag and model folder

ollama list
ollama ps

ollama list shows installed tags. ollama ps shows models currently loaded. If you have more than one server, check the CLI’s OLLAMA_HOST before running either command against the wrong instance. With Docker, check the model volume used by the container running the server.

Ollama documents these default model folders. A server configured with OLLAMA_MODELS uses the directory set for its own process.

  • macOS: ~/.ollama/models
  • Linux service: /usr/share/ollama/.ollama/models
  • Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.ollama\models

Unload the model from memory

Wait until requests using the model have finished. Replace the example with the tag shown by ollama ps.

ollama stop qwen2.5:0.5b
ollama ps
ollama list

The tag should disappear from the running list and stay in the installed list. Another request can load it again from disk. If the running list was already empty, there was no loaded model to stop.

Remove one installed tag

  1. Use ollama list and copy the exact value from the NAME column. Check that apps, scripts and saved configurations are no longer using that tag.
  2. Run the following commands with the tag you intend to remove. If it is loaded, finish any active request and unload it first.
ollama rm qwen2.5:0.5b
ollama list

Deletion succeeded when that exact tag disappears from the same server’s installed list. If Ollama reports the model is missing, recheck the tag and server before trying again. Removing a registry tag means you may need to download it again. Keep the source files required to recreate an imported model.

Why disk space may stay the same after ollama rm

ollama list gives a size for each tag. Two tags can point to the same weights, so adding their listed sizes can overcount the disk space they use. Deleting a tag can leave the shared weight files in place while another tag still uses them.

Compare the actual models folder before and after. On macOS with the default model store, run du -sh "$HOME/.ollama/models" both times. On Windows, check the model folder’s Properties in Explorer. Use the actual server store if you changed its location. Avoid deleting individual blob files by hand because a remaining model can still need them.
